policy_metadata.scope: GPU and PCB Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) Triaging

chunks.title: Section 4.2(c): Electrical Overload & Connector Damage
chunks.clause_text: Damage resulting from electrical overload, external power surges, improper or fluctuating voltage transients, short circuits, or scorched 12VHPWR pin connectors is explicitly excluded from standard limited warranty coverage.
chunks.citation: NVIDIA Hardware Warranty Policy, Rev 2024.2, Section 4.2(c)

chunks.title: Section 2.1(a): Covered Manufacturing Defects
chunks.clause_text: Defects in silicon materials, internal GPU processor die integrity, video memory soldering, or factory workmanship under normal operating parameters are fully covered under standard 3-year limited warranty.
chunks.citation: NVIDIA Hardware Warranty Policy, Rev 2024.2, Section 2.1(a)

chunks.title: CID Section 3.1: PCB Gouges & Broken Traces
chunks.clause_text: Damage to the printed circuit board including more than three severed copper trace lines, deep screwdriver gouges, cracked fiberglass weave, or sheared surface-mount capacitors constitutes non-repairable Customer Induced Damage (CID) and voids warranty.
chunks.citation: ASUS Component Return Policy, Section CID-3.1

chunks.title: CID Section 3.4: Melted Power Input Terminals
chunks.clause_text: Melted plastic connector housings or discolored terminal pins resulting from external cable strain, third-party angle adapters, or improper cable seating are classified as external damage not covered by ASUS limited warranty.
chunks.citation: ASUS Component Return Policy, Section CID-3.4

chunks.title: Section 1.0: 30-Day Unopened Product Returns
chunks.clause_text: Unused products in unopened, original factory-sealed manufacturer packaging with all serial numbers intact are eligible for immediate full refund within thirty (30) calendar days of purchase invoice.

chunks.title: Section 2.2: Serial Number & Warranty Void Seal
chunks.clause_text: Removal, alteration, defacing, or absence of the factory serial number barcode sticker or pierced warranty tamper seal screws immediately terminates all warranty obligations.

chunks.title: Tier 4: Enterprise Hardware Teardown Protocol
chunks.clause_text: All returns with a declared value exceeding $2,500 USD require physical laboratory intake, microscopic X-ray inspection of the BGA solder ball array, and senior forensic engineer sign-off prior to credit or replacement authorization.
chunks.citation: Enterprise Server RMA SLA, Section T4-01
